execution.providerTask: vision-only rig point, capsule bone, and four-frame idle suggestion
execution.nativeApp: Sprite Studio v0.3.2 Tauri dev build

comparison.finding: The local template snapped central body axes with uniformly high confidence; vision-based planning matched the visible arm span and honestly downgraded concealed knees.

gateSequence.detail: Provider points, bones, hierarchy, contacts, and coordinates were structurally valid.
0.1–0.3° conservative motion was below the 8° / 1.5 px / 5% native threshold.
Moving both arms was insufficient while the biped torso stayed below the meaningful-motion threshold.
Opposing ±4° arms plus ±4° upper-torso counter-motion generated four frames.

output.exactRgbaMetricBoundary: Exact per-pixel RGBA mismatch across the full canvas after normalizing fully transparent RGB; this is not the native-v1 duplicate-frame heuristic.

nativeQuality.boundary: Native pixel metrics only; the scores do not prove semantic identity, anatomical correctness, or artistic quality.

humanReview.identity: PASS for a subtle idle; face, palette, clothing, and silhouette remain sourced from the same master pixels.
humanReview.motion: CONDITIONAL; readable only as a small idle, while native QA flags frames 2→3 and 3→4 as near-duplicates.
humanReview.anatomy: CONDITIONAL; wide trousers conceal knees, so walk/run is not approved from this source master.
humanReview.adoption: Use the current asset for idle and UI presentation. Generate or author a motion-ready master with separated limbs before locomotion testing.
